$comment: Source clean-room wall for pi_agent_rust's 'MIT + OpenAI/Anthropic Rider' license:
the Software and derivatives may not be made available to a Restricted Party
(OpenAI/Anthropic, affiliates/agents). Claude Code is an Anthropic surface, so the
source of pi_agent_rust / asupersync / franken-* must never enter agent context.
Read() rules cover every on-disk shape the source can take: any checkout/clone of
pi_agent_rust (the leading **/ matches a clone anywhere), the cargo git checkout,
and the cargo registry sources of the restricted runtime deps. The WebFetch deny
blocks raw.githubusercontent.com (the raw-source fetch channel); GitHub *issue*
pages (prose) stay readable. The Bash PreToolUse hook closes the cat/grep/git-show
channel Read() rules do not cover. The MIT ancestor github.com/earendil-works/pi
carries no rider and is deliberately NOT denied.
Presence of these rules is gated by scripts/check-cleanroom.sh (pretest/package +
